summary: A Quote subscription survives the broker dropping the socket: the feed logs in again, asks for order updates again, subscribes the touchline again, and the snapshot Noren answers with is served.

notes: The desktop drops its cached snapshots on a new connection (appendix item 11); the web's Flattrade adapter keeps them. A full snapshot follows every subscribe, so both serve the same frame here.

deviations.reason: The web's Flattrade adapter forwards Noren's ltt as text (HH:MM:SS), or null when the frame has none; feed times are epoch milliseconds (docs), and a text copy of a time is not sent (docs/port/market-data-frames.md). The Noren family sends no ltt key (feed/dialect/names.rs).

The web's Flattrade adapter sends Noren's pc as percent_change only, with no price_change keys; the desktop sends the canonical price_change and price_change_percent beside percent_change. Lead ruling 2026-11-09: the Noren members turn the canonical change keys off and keep percent_change, by lane wire's per-broker key rule (pending).
